newsitem.title: INDONESIA: ICO postpones seminar on coffee prices.
newsitem.headline: ICO postpones seminar on coffee prices.

text.p: The International Coffee Organization (ICO), which links 61 producing and consuming nations, has postponed its seminar on price determination planned for May, ICO spokesman Pablo Dubois said on Tuesday.

"The (executive) board decided (on Tuesday) there should be a preliminary study first on the issue of price determination, which could then form the groundwork for an eventual seminar," he told reporters on the second day of a three-day ICO meeting.
The ICO meeting on the Indonesian resort island of Bali is to be followed by a gathering of Asia-Pacific coffee producers, and a meeting of robusta producers on Thursday.
Dubois said no date had been fixed yet for the seminar, adding that it would depend on the study to be carried out.
He said the study would cover factors that influence how prices moved, such as technical and fundamental analysis, the influence of producers and that of roaster buying strategies.
"The question is to try to look and see under what conditions those particular factors are most influential...because that is not clear," he said.
He said the study would be presented at the ICO's executive board meeting on May 19 in London.
Dubois also said the Tuesday ICO meeting agreed to undertake a feasibility study for a global research network on coffee.
"The network could potentially be very beneficial because it would avoid duplication of research and speed up research in certain areas," he said, without giving further details.
